findings.recommendation: Log only safe summaries, IDs, counts, and sanitized errors. Never log keys/secrets/full request bodies.

findings.title: localStorage/sessionStorage usage
findings.details: Browser storage is readable by JavaScript and unsafe for sensitive tokens.
findings.recommendation: Use HttpOnly cookies for auth tokens. Do not store access/refresh tokens in localStorage.

findings.title: Cookie set without obvious security flags
findings.details: Cookies should be HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, and have a reasonable path/maxAge.
findings.recommendation: Ensure auth cookies use httpOnly: true, secure: true in production, sameSite: 'lax' or 'strict'.

findings.title: Potential user input used directly
findings.details: User input should be validated and length-limited before database/API usage.
findings.recommendation: Validate type, length, allowed values, and reject unknown fields.
